title: Strata — an optimizing compiler to WebAssembly
description: A from-scratch optimizing compiler that turns a small C-like language into real WebAssembly bytecode in your browser: SSA, SCCP/GVN/LICM/DCE/inlining, if-conversion to branchless select, and a relooper backend. Does floating point from scratch, both directions: str(float) is a genuine Dragon4 shortest-round-trip formatter written in the language itself, and parse_float its correctly-rounded inverse. Now ships a full transcendental math library (exp/ln/log2/log10/sin/cos/tan/asin/acos/atan/atan2/sinh/cosh/tanh/pow/cbrt/hypot/fmod, plus sqrt/floor/round/…) written ONCE as a shared Strata kernel that the wasm backend compiles and the reference interpreter runs — so they agree bit-for-bit, and a dedicated oracle proves each is within ~1 ULP of libm. Plus a real f32 single-precision type lowered end to end to the wasm f32 opcodes (arithmetic, compare, conversions, f32[], f32 struct fields), structs with nested/recursive layouts and a null handle, 64-bit long → wasm i64 (BigInt-exact, hex/L literals, long[], str(long)), bit primitives (popcount/clz/ctz/rotl/rotr), do-while/switch, a string standard library with str[] (split/join), a step debugger, and a differential test suite proving the wasm matches a reference interpreter at every opt level. NEW: first-class functions — a fn(…)->R type whose values are real function pointers, called through a wasm function table and call_indirect, usable in variables/params/returns/struct-field vtables, with a devirtualization pass that turns provable indirect calls back into direct ones at -O1+; this unlocks genuine higher-order programming (map/reduce, a comparator sort, compose). NEWEST: arrays of function pointers — (fn(…)->…)[] via fn_array(n) — a real jump table / state machine, with function-table slot 0 reserved as a null funcref so an unset slot traps on call and fn == null is an observable 'is this wired up?' test; the flagship is a stack-based bytecode VM whose entire decode step is one table[op](vm, imm) lowering to call_indirect. All proven by the differential harness (716 checks across -O0..-O3). NEWEST: division/remainder by a constant — strength reduction that turns every `/ C` and `% C` (32- AND 64-bit) into the textbook multiply/shift/add sequences: power-of-two shifts with a round-toward-zero bias, and the signed magic-number multiply of Hacker's Delight, including a from-scratch 64-bit high-multiply synthesized purely from i64 ops since wasm has no mulhi. At -O1+ the hardware i32.div_s/i64.div_s opcodes vanish entirely, each rewrite an EXACT identity (never an approximation) proven bit-for-bit against the reference interpreter at every level and fuzzed over millions of dividends including INT_MIN/INT_MAX. NEWEST: MEMORY OPTIMIZATION — the first pass to reason about linear memory. An alias analysis (address → base SSA value + constant byte offset; same-base disjoint ranges proven non-aliasing, any different base conservatively may-alias) drives a forward available-memory dataflow (a MUST analysis, meet = intersection, iterated to a fixpoint) that does store→load forwarding (a field written then read back becomes the value), redundant-load elimination (the same element loaded twice loads once), dead-store elimination (a field overwritten before any read isn't stored) and silent-store elimination (writing a value a cell already holds is a no-op). Conservative by precondition — a call clears all facts, print is a read-only barrier, i8 byte stores are never forwarded — so it can only ever miss, never miscompile; a particle step()'s read-modify-write burst collapses from 8 memory ops to 1 at -O1, proven behaviour-preserving by the differential oracle. NEWEST: SROA — ESCAPE ANALYSIS + SCALAR REPLACEMENT OF AGGREGATES, the optimization that makes the record DISAPPEAR. Struct construction lowers to a first-class `alloc` IR op (the string runtime keeps the raw bump sequence, so a fresh allocation is never confused with a heap-pointer rewind — the exact soundness subtlety that blocked this before). Escape analysis traces each handle and every address derived from it by adding a constant: if it is only ever the base of its own field loads/stores — never stored, returned, compared, passed to a call, or merged through a phi — the record is provably private and aliases nothing, so each field is promoted out of memory by FULL CYTRON SSA CONSTRUCTION (dominance-frontier phi placement over the field's store sites + a dominator-tree rename), turning a field written before a branch into a phi at the merge and one accumulated in a loop into a loop-header phi. Because the handle provably aliases nothing, promotion forwards straight across calls — where the memory pass must stay conservative — and memopt now proves two distinct allocations disjoint. The 2D-vectors example at -O2 (helpers inlined) drops from 164 wasm instructions / 506 bytes to 12 / 139 — all four allocations and 21 memory ops gone — and a Particle step() melts to ZERO allocs and ZERO memory ops at -O1, conditional bounce writes and all. Every promotion an exact rewrite, proven bit-for-bit by the differential oracle. NEWEST: 128-BIT SIMD VECTORS — first-class data parallelism lowered to real wasm v128. Four shapes (int4=i32x4, float4=f32x4, long2=i64x2, double2=f64x2) are full value types: locals, parameters, return values, loop-carried phis, even a v128 typed-select out of if-conversion. Elementwise operators map one-to-one to the lane ops (f32x4.add/sub/mul/div, i32x4 add/sub/mul, whole-vector v128.and/or/xor/not for &|^~), with a builtin library for everything else: int4(a,b,c,d) / int4(x) splat, lane(v,k) / withlane(v,k,x) (constant lane immediates), hsum reduction, vmin/vmax/vsqrt/vabs, the six lanewise comparisons veq/vne/vlt/vle/vgt/vge that yield an integer mask, vselect(mask,a,b) (a bit-exact v128.bitselect), and to_float4/to_int4 (saturating f32x4↔i32x4 convert). The whole family flows untouched through the optimizer — GVN deduplicates lane ops, DCE drops dead vectors, the stackifier folds single-use vectors straight onto the operand stack — and the reference interpreter models each lane with the matching rounding (Math.fround per f32 lane, i32/i64 wrap, byte-exact bitselect), so the headline branchless SIMD-Mandelbrot example (four pixels per step, escape counts accumulated through a compare mask) is proven identical to the wasm at every level. All told the differential oracle now runs 836 checks across -O0..-O3. NEWEST: A FROM-SCRATCH WEBASSEMBLY VM — a third, independent engine that runs the compiled program. It decodes the very bytes the backend assembled (an independent binary decoder: LEB128, every section, re-validating the encoder) and executes them on a hand-written stack machine — full dispatch for every numeric op on i32/i64/f32/f64, the conversions and saturating truncations, 128-bit SIMD, structured control flow, linear memory, globals, the funcref table + call_indirect, and the print imports — with i64 as BigInt and f32 as Math.fround so it matches wasm bit-for-bit. It joins the cross-check: every Verify run now proves V8 = reference interpreter = this VM (836 checks), a far stronger guarantee than two engines agreeing, and a dedicated harness reports the VM retired ~147.7M instructions exercising 157 distinct opcodes across the corpus. The same machine, stepped one instruction at a time, powers a new WASM VM TIME-TRAVEL DEBUGGER: step / step-back / run over the real bytecode with the executing instruction highlighted in a live disassembly and panels for the operand stack, locals, call stack, globals and a linear-memory hexdump — watch the actual compiled wasm execute, and rewind. NEWEST: OPERATOR STRENGTH REDUCTION ON INDUCTION VARIABLES (OSR) — the classic Cooper-Simpson-Vick transformation, the one loop optimization Strata was missing. On a loop the unroller can't touch (a runtime or large trip count), a multiply (or shift) of an induction variable by a loop-invariant region constant — the `i*stride` of an array address, a polynomial term — would otherwise run EVERY iteration. OSR replaces it with a NEW induction variable advanced by an ADDITION each iteration (init*r in the preheader, stepped by c*r per latch), the exact move that turns base + i*stride into a running pointer bump. It is an exact identity in the wrapping ring Z/2^w — (i±c)*r ≡ i*r ± c*r (mod 2^w), shifts as r=2^(k mod w) — so the result is byte-for-byte what -O0 computes; floats are excluded because FP rounding breaks distributivity. It handles i32 and i64 IVs, multiple latches, decrementing IVs, negative and loop-invariant-variable region constants, and several candidates per loop, declining whenever a precondition is unrecognized so it can only ever strengthen the code. Proven by the three-engine oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) AND an offline fuzz of 9,600 random loops (OSR firing on 71%, zero mismatches); the corpus now runs 884 differential checks across -O0..-O3, OSR firing on 91 of 221 programs. NEWEST: LOOP UNSWITCHING — the loop optimization that attacks control flow. When a loop body branches on a loop-INVARIANT condition (a runtime flag whose single SSA definition lies outside the loop, so it never changes across iterations), re-deciding the branch every iteration is pure waste. Unswitching turns the loop inside-out: it hoists the test ABOVE the loop and clones the loop into two specialized, branch-free versions — `for { if (C) A else B }` becomes `if (C) { for { A } } else { for { B } }` — then the following SCCP/DCE/CFG-simplify rounds delete each clone's dead arm. It is the one LICM, if-conversion and unrolling could not get (LICM hoists the condition but not the branch; if-conversion only flattens a diamond to a still-per-iteration select; unrolling needs a constant trip count), and it composes with all of them — the two clean clones then unroll/stride/vectorize. A LICM pass runs first to lift the in-loop condition icmp into the preheader so the branch reads as invariant. Sound by the same structured-loop precondition the unroller uses (single preheader; the header conditional is the loop's one exit), which makes the exit SSA repair exact — every escaping value is a header def, merged back at the single exit with a fresh phi — and it declines whenever a precondition is unmet, so a bug can only miss an opportunity, never miscompile. A runtime-flagged loop's preheader now tests the flag once and feeds two branch-free clones whose results merge at the exit, proven identical by the three-engine oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) AND a seeded fuzz of 240 random loops-with-invariant-branches (unswitching firing on every -O2/-O3 compile, zero mismatches); the full differential battery now runs 1068 checks across -O0..-O3. NEWEST: CODE SINKING (partial dead-code elimination) — the dual of LICM. A pure value computed before a two-way branch but used on only ONE arm was still computed on every path, the result thrown away whenever the other arm ran. Sinking pushes it DOWN into the arm that needs it — `t = a*a+b*b; if (cond) { use t } else { … }` becomes `if (cond) { t = a*a+b*b; use t } else { … }` — so the other path never computes it, and t's live range shrinks (easing the stackifier). Where LICM lifts invariants out of a loop, sinking pushes conditionally-used values into the branch that uses them. Sound by precondition: the target arm must be entered only from the branch block (so the value's operands, available there, survive the move), every use must be dominated by that arm, the value must not feed a phi (whose use is on a predecessor edge), and it refuses to sink into a deeper loop nest so it never pessimizes — moving work off a path, never changing a result. Proven by the three-engine oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) AND a seeded fuzz of 240 random programs with a value used on only one arm (sinking firing on 212 of the -O2/-O3 compiles, zero mismatches); the full differential battery now runs 1080 checks across -O0..-O3. NEWEST: CODE HOISTING (very-busy / partially-redundant expressions) — sinking's mirror. When BOTH arms of a branch begin by computing the same pure value, GVN/CSE can't dedupe it (neither arm dominates the other, so it's a partial not a dominating redundancy) and if-conversion only helps when both arms are pure and small. Hoisting pulls one copy UP above the branch — `if (cond) { e = a*a+b*b; … } else { e = a*a+b*b; … }` becomes `e = a*a+b*b; if (cond) { … } else { … }` — so it runs once instead of on each path. Together the four directions of code motion are now covered: LICM lifts invariants up out of a loop, unswitching hoists an invariant branch above a loop, sinking pushes a one-arm value down into its arm, and hoisting pulls a both-arms value up out of them. Sound by the same single-pred precondition as sinking (each arm entered only from the branch block, so a value computed there is available wherever the originals were) with only pure, branch-block-available operands eligible — so it never adds a path, only removes a duplicate; sub-expression chains lift over successive fixpoint rounds. Proven by the three-engine oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) AND a seeded fuzz of 240 random programs whose two arms share an expression (hoisting firing on every -O2/-O3 compile, zero mismatches); the full differential battery now runs 1088 checks across -O0..-O3. NEWEST: A SOURCE-LEVEL DEBUGGER FOR THE COMPILED WASM — the compiler now emits debug info (a DWARF-lite line table) and the from-scratch WebAssembly VM becomes a real source debugger. Source spans are threaded from the AST through the IR (each instruction and each conditional/return terminator), preserved across SSA construction and the optimizer's clones, and the backend builds a line table INSIDE the byte encoder — exactly one source location per emitted wasm instruction, in the same order the disassembler reads them back, so the mapping is the decoder's inverse (1:1 by construction, not a heuristic). The VM consumes it: single-step the REAL, optimized bytecode and the matching source line lights up live in the editor; click line numbers (or disassembly Lnn badges) to set breakpoints and ⛒ continue runs the machine until it hits one; the disassembly tags every instruction with its source line and highlights the whole group an instruction came from, so you watch one line of source become N instructions — and watch the optimizer delete/merge them as you raise -O (84% of instructions map at -O0). Stepping into the Strata runtime library (__strcat, the transcendental kernels, Dragon4) is labelled as such rather than pointing at a phantom line. The line table is pure metadata that changes no emitted byte, so the three-engine differential oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) is untouched and still agrees byte-for-byte at every level — 1096 checks — while a new dedicated harness proves the table itself: 6459 line-table checks across 4767 functions at -O0..-O3 (alignment, source-bounds, coverage, plus a live step/breakpoint test), all green. NEWEST: PARTIAL-REDUNDANCY ELIMINATION (GVN-PRE) — the capstone of the redundancy family. GVN deletes a computation a DOMINATING one already made, LICM lifts a FULLY invariant value out of a loop, hoisting pulls a BOTH-arms value up; none of them touch the PARTIAL redundancy — an expression recomputed after a control-flow merge where only SOME incoming paths already produced it. PRE makes it total then deletes it: it splits critical edges, value-numbers the function, computes AVAIL_OUT (forward over the dominator tree) and ANTIC_IN (backward fixpoint with φ-translation), then at each merge inserts the expression on the lacking edges and fuses the per-edge leaders with a φ that becomes the value's new leader — the value-based form of Knoop-Rüthing-Steffen lazy code motion (VanDrunen & Hosking's GVN-PRE), so a recomputation on the already-computed path becomes a reuse, with never a path computing it more often than before. Only pure never-trapping families move (no loads/stores/calls, div_s/rem_s, or trapping float→int casts) so an insertion can never invent a fault or a side effect, and as a backstop the pass re-verifies SSA dominance and discards all its work if anything is off — a latent bug degrades to a no-op, never a miscompile. Proven by the three-engine oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) at -O0..-O3 — corpus 1188 → 1212 — plus a seeded 1,280-check differential fuzz (PRE firing in 540 of the -O2/-O3 compiles, zero disagreements). NEWEST: ALGEBRAIC DATA TYPES — `enum` tagged unions + `match` pattern matching, the feature that makes it a real language. An enum declares named variants each carrying a typed payload (`enum Shape { Circle(float), Rect(float,float), Empty }`, and recursively `enum Expr { Num(int), Add(Expr,Expr) }`); you construct one by variant name (`Circle(3.0)`, bare `Empty`) and take it apart with `match`, which binds the payload, ignores fields with `_`, allows a `_` wildcard, and is checked at COMPILE TIME for exhaustiveness (miss a variant and it won't compile) as well as duplicate, foreign and unreachable arms. Exactly like structs it needed NO new IR concept and NO backend/optimizer change: an enum value is an i32 handle to { tag word, payload }, so construction is an `alloc` + a tag store + a store per field and a `match` is a tag load + a switch-style branch chain + per-arm field loads into the bindings — and every existing pass consumes the i32 handles unchanged. Verified the optimizer handles it: SROA scalarizes a non-escaping single-construction enum and SCCP folds its tag to delete the dead arm; a phi-merged handle stays sound via SROA's no-phi escape rule; recursive enums and enums nested in other enums' payloads need no special case. Strict by design — no implicit conversions, no null, no `==` (match instead), not a global — with a type-canonicalization pass that rewrites the parser's struct-tagged annotations that actually name an enum (through arrays, function-pointer signatures and every let/for in a body). The reference interpreter and the step debugger model an enum as {enum, variant, fields}; the from-scratch VM sees only i32 handles + memory ops it already ran, so all three agree by construction. Shipped with three catalog examples (an ADT/Option intro, a recursive expression evaluator + pretty-printer, and a two-enum stack-machine bytecode interpreter) and a 10-program adversarial battery; the differential oracle now runs 1300 checks across -O0..-O3, all green. NEWEST: VALUE-RANGE PROPAGATION (VRP) — a flow-sensitive integer interval analysis, the pass that reasons about what values a variable can actually hold. Every i32/i64 SSA value gets a signed range [lo,hi] (BigInt bounds, so the reasoning never itself overflows) that is a sound over-approximation, threaded along the CFG with per-edge GUARD REFINEMENT: on the true arm of `if (x < y)` it assumes the comparison and narrows x and y, and a block's entry range is the HULL of its predecessors' — so a single-edge narrowing evaporates at a multi-pred merge but keeps full strength down a single-predecessor arm. Transfer functions cover add/sub/mul (kept only when the result provably can't wrap), bit-and/or/xor of non-negatives, shifts, constant div/rem, and clz/ctz/popcount width bounds. It then folds any comparison a derived range settles — `(x & 7) < 8`, `x % 10 >= 0`, `popcount(x) <= 32`, a chained `a < b … a < b+1` — into a constant, turning the branch above it into an unconditional jump; this is the classic correlated-value-propagation (LLVM's LazyValueInfo, GCC's tree-VRP) that strictly SUBSUMES the earlier correlated-branch folding (which only decides a branch from an IDENTICAL dominating test) with genuine numeric implication, and it works on `long` (i64) exactly as on `int`. As a bonus it owns a rewrite the constant-divisor strength reducer can't make — range-based remainder/division elimination, where a dividend proven to lie in [0,|c|-1] makes `x % c` the identity and `x / c` exactly zero. Loop headers are pinned to ⊤ so a single reverse-postorder sweep is a fixpoint and every range stays a safe over-approximation. Behaviour-preserving by construction — a fold fires only when the interval PROVES the result — and proven by the three-engine oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) at -O0..-O3 (corpus 1300 → 1320) plus a seeded 1,040-check range fuzzer (VRP firing in 508 of the -O2/-O3 compiles, zero disagreements). NEWEST: KNOWN-BITS — a bitwise (congruence) lattice analysis, VRP's orthogonal twin. Where VRP tracks a value's MAGNITUDE (a signed interval), known-bits tracks its INDIVIDUAL BITS: every i32/i64 SSA value gets two W-bit masks — bits proven 0 and bits proven 1 on every execution — a sound must-over-approximation exactly like LLVM's KnownBits / GCC's bit-CCP. One reverse-postorder must-analysis whose control-flow merges take the bitwise MEET (a bit survives only where every path agrees) and whose loop-carried phis fall to ⊤, so a single sweep is a fixpoint; transfer functions cover and/or/xor, constant shifts (with arithmetic sign-fill), carry-aware add/sub low bits, mul trailing zeros (valuations add), clz/ctz/popcnt width bounds, i2l/l2i/select, and eq/ne decided from a disagreeing known bit. It unlocks three rewrites the interval domain simply cannot express: a value whose EVERY BIT IS KNOWN collapses to a constant even when computed through masks and shifts that defeat SCCP and VRP (`((a&255)<<8)&255 ≡ 0`); a REDUNDANT MASK/SET is dropped (`x & C → x` when ~C is already known-zero, `x | C → x` when C is already known-one); and a PARITY comparison is decided (`(x|1)==0` is always false — a bit fact VRP's disjoint-range test misses). A per-bit MODULAR domain, so wasm's wrapping integer semantics need no special guarding — a real simplification over VRP — and a fold fires only when the bits PROVE the result, so a bug can only miss, never miscompile. Surfaced live in a new BITS INSPECTOR TAB (per-value 1/0/· masks + derived facts: fully-known constant, trailing-zero alignment, leading zeros, bit-count, ones/zeros hex) and a `bittricks` example. Proven by the three-engine oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) at -O0..-O3 (corpus 1344 → 1348) plus a seeded 1,040-check bit-twiddling fuzzer (known-bits firing in 520 of the -O2/-O3 compiles, zero disagreements). NEWEST: GENERICS — parametric polymorphism by MONOMORPHIZATION, the one first-class language feature Strata was missing. Write a function once with type parameters — `fn max<T>(a: T, b: T) -> T`, `fn fold<T, A>(xs: T[], init: A, g: fn(A, T) -> A) -> A` — and the compiler stamps out one specialised, fully-concrete clone per type it is called at (`max$int`, `max$float`, `max$long`), rewriting each call to its instantiation. Type arguments are INFERRED from the call's argument types by structural unification (no turbofish `f<int>(…)`), through `T`, `T[]`, and `fn(T)->U`, with a fixpoint worklist so one generic calling another (`clamp<T>` → `minT<T>`/`maxT<T>`) instantiates transitively, and it works over struct handles too. The whole thing is a PURE FRONT-END ELABORATION run before the type checker, IR builder, optimizer and backend: by the time any of them (or the reference interpreter, or the from-scratch VM) runs, every type parameter is gone and only ordinary monomorphic Strata remains — no new IR, no new value representation, not a single line of the heavily-tuned mid-end or backend touched. The body is duck-typed per instantiation (like a C++ template): an operator is only ever checked on the concrete clone, so a bug can only produce a clone the EXISTING checker rejects with a clean compile error, never a silent miscompile — a program that instantiates `a + b` at a struct is caught, not mangled. Proven by the three-engine oracle (V8 = interpreter = VM) at -O0..-O3 (corpus 1348 → 1376) plus a dedicated generics harness that asserts the exact set of clones each program produces, the ten rejection paths, and that a generic program compiles to byte-identical output as its hand-written monomorphic twin. NEWEST: 64-BIT LANE AUTO-VECTORIZATION — the auto-vectorizer, formerly i32x4/f32x4-only, now widens the entire 64-bit world. It picks the lane shape from the array element type and with it the lane count and byte stride: long[] → i64x2 and float[] (f64) → f64x2, both 2 lanes to a v128 register (the 32-bit shapes keep their 4× width). A float[] kernel packs f64x2.mul/add/… — bit-exact because each lane rounds in IEEE-754 double exactly like the scalar path (no reassociation); a long[] kernel packs i64x2.mul/add + whole-register v128.and/or/xor, and an i64 REDUCTION folds 2 lanes at a time into a v128 accumulator then a 2-lane horizontal reduce — bit-exact because + * & | ^ are associative+commutative mod 2^64. FLOAT reductions stay declined (lane-reordered rounding would differ), as do stencils and integer division (no SIMD int-divide). The dependence-soundness argument closes unchanged at 2 lanes: the ≥ W-live-element guard (≥ ARRAY_HEADER + 16 bytes, a full v128 either shape) keeps distinct bump allocations from ever colliding across lanes, and the original loop is always reused verbatim as the scalar remainder — a bug can only miss, never miscompile. The change is essentially LOCAL to the vectorizer: the SIMD IR, codegen, byte encoder and from-scratch VM already spoke i64x2/f64x2 from the explicit-vector value types, so the transform reuses the identical proven splice/guard/remainder machinery. Proven by the three-engine oracle (interpreter = V8 = VM) at -O0..-O3 with zero regressions across the full corpus (348 programs × 4 levels), three new corpus tests (vec-i64-map, vec-i64-reduce over all five i64 monoids with real 64-bit overflow, vec-f64-axpy), a 1,040-run randomized i64/f64 kernel+reduction fuzz (244/260 emitting the target shape, zero mismatches), and decline-path checks confirming integer-divide/stencil/float-sum loops stay correct and emit no SIMD.
